scope: Fill and appearance rules checked against the locally supplied ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3 text, 12.7.4.3 and 12.7.5.2-12.7.5.4 (Tables 228-234), 12.5.5 and 12.5.6.19 (Table 192). Scalar-value length, CR normalization, auto-size, padding, line wrapping and selection colors are explicit reader policies. Filled page compilation applies temporary appearances without modifying source objects; saving remains outside the API. Null-as-absent entries follow 7.3.9. Text-state setup and the distinction between valid negative font sizes and unsupported generation were checked against 9.3 and 9.4.1 (Tables 102-105). Explicit state reset before DA is generation policy to keep layout independent of an old appearance prefix.

requirements.gaps: Rich text, XFA and actions remain unsupported or inert; DoNotScroll is checked during appearance generation. Passwords remain in caller-owned memory.
An absent AP permits a generated ZaDb mark; existing state dictionaries are only selected, never replaced.
V contains displayed names per Table 234; exports remain separate. Ambiguity requires explicit option indexes.

requirements.status: implemented as data and filled-page compilation
requirements.gaps: No saving. Composite font encoding, oblique Tm and updates containing inline images or multiple Tx sections fail explicitly. Existing Tx sections inside BT or crossing graphics scopes fail explicitly.

requirements.status: implemented for solid, dashed and underline borders
requirements.gaps: Rotated widgets, beveled/inset and rounded borders fail explicitly. Detailed layout and sizing are documented reader policy.
No saving or host protocol edits. Generation retains the supported font and layout capabilities of forms-appearance-update.
Exact rational polygons with tolerance 1; generated bytes use buffer positions rather than invented source identities.
Only visible page widgets are prepared. Direct malformed widgets without a shared source identity cannot be associated by value or name.
NeedAppearances regenerates visible text and choice fields; existing button states are preserved unless changed.

Reader policy: an untouched field with NeedAppearances may retain an existing AP on Unsupported, reported as form.appearance-kept information, valid in Strict mode too. Edited fields and other errors fail explicitly. Source objects are immutable.
